label_scope: known-label metrics over recorded VAL outcomes only; UNKNOWN proposals are never negatives

rule.delta: learned - analytical, paired root-cluster bootstrap 95% CI on VAL roots
rule.PROMISING: known-label precision delta CI lower > 0 AND hit@4 delta CI lower > -0.02
rule.ANALYTICAL_AHEAD: analytical significantly better on hit@4 or precision (delta CI upper < 0) AND learned not significantly better on the other
rule.TIED: both delta CIs contain 0 and both |point deltas| < 0.02
rule.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else (e.g. a significant trade-off: learned better precision, analytical better hit)
